The L1 landed and committed everything under attack BEFORE this wave: the claims and their receipts live at the lane tip named in the dispatch message. Claims under attack: C1 (calibration; cold-read monitor refresh of the four round-35-drifted SKILL headings restores credit 6 -> 8 per `python3 /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin/.ufo/evidence/round-21/coldread/measure.py --repo /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin --rev REV`) and C2 (depth surface; successor counter `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin/.ufo/evidence/round-36/c1/c1-measure-v2.py` adds frozen public-slot cardinality + distinctness asserts 6/3/9 over the round-35 tally-audit panel). Contract: `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin/.ufo/evidence/round-36/contract.json`. The L1 holds the canonical planner seat (orchestrator ruling 2026-10-19: planner is a frozen-topology seat, never a swarm role); a bounded planning data-walk rides this wave's scout/connector items.

- Your tools start at the FLEET ROOT. Every path you use MUST be absolute; a relative path such as `.ufo/waves/...` lands in the FLEET repo and is a scope violation. Every `Report:` trailer the dispatcher prints is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin/<that path>, which is the ONLY lane path you may create.

Tooling directive (operator 2026-10-19): you may install or upgrade tools that help the task without asking, via `uv tool install`, `npx`, or an official release binary into `~/.local/bin` — official sources only, never piped remote scripts; record tool/version/channel/reason in your report.
